# SpatialDataAgent-DB toolkit

> A Python package, CLI (`sda-db`) and MCP server for SpatialDataAgent-DB. The atlas holds 12,163 public spatial transcriptomics samples from 1,265 GEO studies in the paper release v1.0.0-20261025. Each sample has verified AnnData expression, coordinates and sample.json metadata; 8,211 also have a registered pyramidal tissue image.
> Searching needs no account. Downloading needs approved Hugging Face access.

Key facts for agents:

- The CLI prints compact JSON when piped. Errors go to stderr as {"error": {code, message, hint}}, with exit codes 2–8.
- Plan before downloading (`sda-db download ... --dry-run`); the full release is about 1.8 TB.
- Check expression_state before count-based methods, and coordinate_units / um_basis before using micrometres.
- Keep the release split and each study together for machine learning.

- [AI agents and MCP](https://github.com/Biogod2020/spatial-data-agent-db/blob/main/docs/agents.md): MCP setup for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, VS Code; tools; safety limits
- [Python API](https://github.com/Biogod2020/spatial-data-agent-db/blob/main/docs/python-api.md): Catalog, search, plan/download, load, images, errors
